findings.title: Runaway re-render on /render-loop
findings.summary: /render-loop mutates the DOM ~23967 times/second for as long as it is mounted, in 4 of 4 visits. A view that has finished rendering goes quiet; one that keeps mutating is re-rendering in a loop and will pin a CPU core.

fix.summary: Break the state-update cycle in the component's effect
fix.hint: Look for a useEffect that sets state it also depends on, a missing or incorrect dependency array, or an object/array literal recreated every render and passed as a dependency.

findings.title: Console error on /log-error
findings.summary: The app logged an error 5 times on /log-error: Failed to parse user preferences, falling back to defaults. The page kept running, so this is a defect the app knows about and swallowed rather than a hard crash.

metrics.message: Failed to parse user preferences, falling back to defaults

fix.summary: Resolve the logged error rather than silencing it
fix.hint: Read the message and fix the underlying cause.

findings.title: JS heap recovers slowly after load
findings.summary: JS heap only recovers 71% after GC. Not a hard leak, but worth a look (cache sizing / retained closures).

fix.hint: Bound caches and ensure transient buffers are released.
